title: Owned correlation results do not retain the original bootstrap ledger lifetime
IR01_token_refund_correction: Independently established within the original live ledger; this finding is not a Complete-token or refund bypass.
contract_basis: Root contract amendment requires a caller-retained BootstrapLedger borrowed by reservations/owners. Broad charge coverage also needs an accountable root to remain alive for every charged proof/result/resource carrier. Permanent storage in a ledger that can itself end is not proof of that lifetime coverage.

evidence.production_API_signature: fn escape<'root>(owner: AdmittedImmutableOwnerV1<'root>, supplied: SuppliedLoaderCarrierV1) -> OwnedCorrelationOutcomeV1
production_API_trace: Call owner.correlation_scope_v1(); pass its actual expected and one-shot attempt plus the complete supplied carrier into correlate_admitted_loader_v1.
End expected/attempt borrows after obtaining the owned result.
Consume owner through retire_admitted_owner_v1(owner); the barrier conservatively retains the charge and drops acquisition backing.
Return the same OwnedCorrelationOutcomeV1, which has no root lifetime. No private field reads, fabricated File, native execution or test-only constructor is needed in this helper.
evidence.helper_scope: Additional cfg(test) function compiled against exact production-visible opaque File facade APIs in both successful test builds; never executed and not an external-crate metadata test.
evidence.host_witness_scope: Actual generic production admission/correlation/retirement core specialized with original private guards and actual validator-created proof; acquisition owner dropped, original lexical ledger ends, then original proof pointer, 1947 source bytes and loader guards20..23 remain accessible.
evidence.observed_in_both_modes: last live ledger storage1000000; original acquisition guards0..12 dropped; proof/guards survive ledger end; no Complete token or release was invoked.

current_concrete_caller_limit: consume_admitted_owner_once_v1 keeps bindings/scopes inside the owner lifetime, obtains child under a separate TrustedHostAccount, observes and destroys owned_child, releases only its child token, then retires acquisition owner and returns scalar observations. This particular caller does not return the escaping correlation payload.
native_reachability_limit: No native admitted owner can currently be constructed by the selected production startup/custody path. NativeInputBridgeV1 always refuses healthy retirement. This review establishes neither an existing native escape nor a production refund.
disposition: Keep full root/result-lifetime and charge-coverage acceptance Pending. A narrow IR01 no-Complete/no-refund repair can be accepted independently. Do not claim whole ownership, useful joint retirement, native funding, source prices or GA.
